integrity: The proof derives all nontrivial Fourier inequalities exactly. Numeric checks supplement but do not replace the all-exponent proof. Character tables and the Schoenberg criterion are classical inputs, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The statement classifies the all-damping property only on the 60-element rotation subgroup. It does not describe every individual damping value for exponents above the cutoff, or the complete SO(3) manifold. No independent audit or validation was performed; literature review cannot rule out unindexed equivalent prior results.
title: Sharp negative-type exponent for the icosahedral rotation-angle metric
